derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4476 (ῥαφίς);
def: to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle

occurrences.text: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
